source_rule: Перед репликой NPC о прошлом — его prior_disclosures в GM_BRIEF и страница memory/npc/<id>.talk. Ссылки на источники после сцены не требуются; свёртка отмечает повтор старого как нового.
knowledge_rule: Offscreen NPC knowledge requires channel and source; GM-only knowledge stays in GM_ONLY.
world_rule: Every newly crossed time deadline must be explicitly resolved or reviewed before the next canonical turn.
fallback: If sources are unavailable, do not invent new facts. Read the exact archived turn; never bypass a failed gate by fabricating review markers.
